agenda_items.section: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor Appelbaum called the regular May 5, 2009 council meeting to order at 6:05 p.m. in the council chambers.

agenda_items.section: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: Presentation of Sister City Volunteer of the Year Award to Harumi Kato.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor Appelbaum presented Harumi Kato with the Sister City Volunteer of the Year Award for her efforts coordinating local volunteers associated with the Sakura Project and the Yamagata Sister City committee to plant cherry trees in Boulder.

agenda_items.title: PUBLIC PARTICIPATION and COUNCIL/STAFF RESPONSE
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council heard public participation and staff and council responses.

agenda_items.title: CONSENT AGENDA
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried 8:0 with Appelbaum opposed to item 3G.

agenda_items.title: APPROVAL OF CITY COUNCIL MEETING MINUTES FROM APRIL 7, 2009.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Approved as amended as part of the consent agenda.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO APPROVE AN INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENT WITH THE CITY OF LAFAYETTE ON OWNERSHIP AND OPERATION OF A SENIOR SERVICES BUS.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Approved as part of the consent agenda.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO APPROVE INTERLOCAL GOVERNMENT AGREEMENTS BETWEEN THE CITY OF BOULDER AND THE COUNTY OF BOULDER; CITY OF LAFAYETTE; CITY OF LONGMONT AND THE CITY OF LOUISVILLE FOR THE FY09 EDWARD BYRNE MEMORIAL JUSTICE ASSISTANCE GRANT PROGRAM.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Approved as part of the consent agenda.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ADOPT A RESOLUTION NO. 1051 IN SUPPORT OF ENHANCING COLLABORATIVE EFFORTS BETWEEN THE BOULDER VALLEY SCHOOL DISTRICT, THE UNIVERSITY OF COLORADO AT BOULDER, BOULDER COUNTY AND THE CITY OF BOULDER TO PROGRESS TOWARD ENVIRONMENTAL SUSTAINABILITY.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Pulled from the consent agenda and adopted as amended by an 8:0 vote after being taken up as a public hearing.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ADOPT A RESOLUTION No. 1052 FINDING THE ANNEXATION PETITION FOR TWO PARCELS LOCATED AT 5880 AND 6032 BUTTE MILL RD., WESTERN DISPOSAL SERVICES, INC. (LUR2003-00013 AND LUR2003-00037) IN COMPLIANCE WITH STATE STATUTES AND ESTABLISHING JUNE 4, 2009 AS THE DATE FOR FINAL ACTION ON THE ANNEXATION REQUEST. OWNER/APPLICANT: WESTERN DISPOSAL SERVICES, INC.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION No. 230 AUTHORIZING THE ISSUANCE BY THE CITY OF BOULDER CENTRAL AREA GENERAL IMPROVEMENT DISTRICT OF ITS GENERAL OBLIGATION REFUNDING BONDS, SERIES 2009, IN THE AGGREGATE PRINCIPAL AMOUNT OF $8,105,000, FOR THE PURPOSE OF PROVIDING FUNDS FOR THE CURRENT REFUNDING OF THE CITY OF BOULDER CENTRAL AREA GENERAL IMPROVEMENT DISTRICT GENERAL OBLIGATION BONDS, SERIES 1998, TOGETHER WITH ALL NECESSARY, INCIDENTAL AND APPURTENANT COSTS AND EXPENSES THEREWITH; PRESCRIBING THE FORM OF SAID SERIES 2009 BONDS; PROVIDING FOR THE SALE OF SAID SERIES 2009 BONDS; ESTABLISHING CERTAIN FUNDS WITH RESPECT THERETO; PROVIDING A PLEDGE OF THE FULL FAITH AND CREDIT OF THE DISTRICT AS SECURITY FOR SAID SERIES 2009 BONDS; MAKING CERTAIN COVENANTS WITH RESPECT TO SAID SERIES 2009 BONDS; APPOINTING ASSURED GUARANTY CORP, AS BOND INSURER FOR SAID SERIES 2009 BONDS; AND PROVIDING OTHER DETAILS IN CONNECTION WITH SAID SERIES 2009 BONDS.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Approved as amended as part of the consent agenda.

agenda_items.outcome_summary: Approved as part of the consent agenda.

motions.motion_text: Deputy Mayor Gray moved, seconded by Morzel to approve consent agenda items 3A through 3K with items 3A and 3F amended and item 3D pulled from consent and taken up as a public hearing later in the meeting.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 8:0 with Appelbaum opposed to item 3G.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Wilson moved, seconded by Osborne to adopt Ordinance No. 7658 amending the requirements related to the protection of wetlands, including Sections 9-3-9, “Wetlands Protection,” 9-16-1, “General Definitions,” and 4-20-53, “Wetland Permit and Map Revision Fees,” B.R.C. 1981, by repealing, reenacting and adopting by reference the wetlands maps of the city of Boulder and the wetlands functional evaluations and setting forth related details.

Council Member Morzel moved, seconded by Espinoza to adopt Ordinance No. 7651 enacting a new Chapter 2-2.5, B.R.C. 1981 addressing civil emergencies and disasters, establishing authority and procedures to take specified actions in the event of a disaster emergency and setting forth related details.

Council Member Gray moved, seconded by Morzel to adopt substitute Ordinance No. 7552 adopting and approving an Intergovernmental Agreement between Boulder County, the City and County of Broomfield, the Cities of Boulder, Lafayette, Longmont, and Louisville, and the Towns of Erie and Superior, relating to the management of hazardous materials; and its Exhibit A found in Attachment B.

Council Member Ageton moved, seconded by Gray to adopt Resolution No. 1051 in support of enhancing collaborative efforts between the Boulder Valley School District, the University of Colorado at Boulder, Boulder County and the City of Boulder to progress toward environmental sustainability; as amended to add “diverse and inclusive” prior to “work force” on page 6 of the agenda memo.

Council Member Cowles moved, seconded by Appelbaum to ratify the Board and Commission appointments. Council appointed Paul Saporito to a five-year term on the Downtown Design Advisory Board and Thomas Krueger to a five-year on the Board of Zoning Adjustment.

Mayor Appelbaum moved, seconded by Morzel to appoint Council Member Morzel with Deputy Mayor Gray as alternate to the Kisumu Sister City Committee and appointing Council Member Wilson as representative to the Yamagata Sister City Committee.
There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 9:40 P. M.
